description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the IBM Db2i database. Only SELECT statements are allowed for security. Results are limited by default to prevent large result sets. Pass chart only when the user asks for a chart or graph. Otherwise leave it out: the result opens as a table and the user can switch to a chart.

chart.description: How to chart the rows. Column names must match the result columns.

horizontal.description: Horizontal bars, for long labels or rankings

series.description: Column whose values become separate series, such as STATUS

target.description: Column with a target or budget, drawn as a line over the bars

type.description: bar, line or area for categories or time; pie or doughnut for a share of six or fewer parts; scatter for two measures; pareto for a ranking with cumulative share; waterfall for a running total (first row is the start value, the rest are changes); histogram to bin one measure; kpi for a one-row result; table for no chart

x.description: Column for categories or time (the x axis)

y.description: Measure columns. Leave out to chart the first measure; name more only when the user asks to compare them

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: QUERY_DEFAULT_LIMIT, max: QUERY_MAX_LIMIT)

name: execute_query

cause.description: Why the statement failed. &1-style placeholders stand for values in error.

chart.description: The chart the result view draws

horizontal.description: Horizontal bars, for long labels or rankings

series.description: Column whose values become separate series, such as STATUS

target.description: Column with a target or budget, drawn as a line over the bars

chartError.description: Why the chart argument was not used

columns.description: Result columns in order, with the kind of value each holds

recovery.description: What to change before trying again

skippedFilters.description: Annotated tables whose row filter, such as leaving out deleted rows, the query does not use. See warnings

sqlcode.description: SQLCODE of the failed statement, such as -204

truncated.description: True when the result stopped at limitApplied and more rows match

warnings.description: Tell the user these, such as columns the driver rounded

title: Execute SQL Query
